basics.name: Edd Mann
basics.label: Lead Software Engineer
basics.summary: Lead Software Engineer with 15+ years building reliable, evolvable systems using DDD, event sourcing, and AWS Serverless. Currently independent, delivering across embedded firmware, cellular telemetry, and cloud-native SaaS. Side projects explore the agentic AI ecosystem and programming-language design; host of Compiled Conversations.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: End-to-end systems across embedded firmware, cellular telemetry, and cloud-native SaaS; currently engaged in the UK railway signalling sector.
highlights: Built a multi-tenant SaaS for parsing and reporting level-crossing signalling logs, using Laravel, AWS Lambda, CDK, Twilio, and web-push.
Built ESP32 telemetry firmware with cellular GPRS, publishing radar-speed and barrier-strike events over MQTT to a Terraform-managed AWS ingest pipeline.
Owned client delivery end-to-end - domain modelling through trackside hardware to cloud-side reporting and alerting.

work.name: Instapro
work.summary: Promoted to Lead Software Engineer following the MyBuilder-Instapro merger; shaped technical direction across teams and led key greenfield projects in a larger organisation.
highlights: Led a major retailer integration service, running event storming sessions and collaborating with stakeholders from design to rollout. Delivered using React, TypeScript, PHP, and AWS Serverless.
Drove architectural direction across teams, breaking up the monolith into vertical-slice services designed around subdomains and bounded contexts.

work.name: MyBuilder
work.summary: Focused on cloud-native infrastructure and platform enablement, supporting development teams and shaping architectural decisions.
highlights: Led a greenfield insurance and underwriting system (MyBuilder Plus), delivered in under six months using DDD, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture, Terraform, and Serverless.
Migrated all services to AWS Lambda, reducing operational overhead and accelerating delivery.

work.name: MyBuilder
work.summary: Promoted to Senior Software Engineer through MyBuilder's 2017 IAC acquisition; led infrastructure strategy and mentored engineers.
highlights: Led migration from on-premises to AWS using Terraform across many AWS services.
Built an event-sourced Tradespeople shortlist billing bounded context within the modular monolith.

work.name: MyBuilder
work.summary: Joined a small, agile team applying modern engineering practices across the stack; supported the move to a modular monolith with bounded contexts.
highlights: Built a greenfield RESTful microservice for Tradespeople trade assessments, ensuring qualification standards on the platform.

projects.name: santa-lang
projects.description: Functional, C-like programming language with five independent implementations - tree-walking interpreters, a bytecode VM, and an LLVM compiler - across Rust, Kotlin, and TypeScript.

projects.name: My Own Coding Agent
projects.description: Educational Python coding agent built from primitives - TUI, CLI, and FastAPI web shell, with provider-agnostic LLM support.

projects.name: Serverless Fargate
projects.description: Serverless Framework plugin for long-running Fargate ECS tasks - 18,000+ weekly downloads on NPM.
